auto_fail_flags.description: The seller agreed to a free pilot without accuracy, latency, or exit gates.

auto_fail_flags.description: Accuracy and latency exit gates never came up in the conversation.

transition_banner.title: Close the deal, then close the workload.
transition_banner.body: Consumption grows only when the eval harness proves value.

drills.title: Paper process and decision process
drills.prompt: Map the approval path and the legal and security lead times before you agree to any pilot scope.

drills.title: Economic buyer and competition
drills.prompt: Find who can approve a seasonal commitment, and find out what the buyer already has in place.

drills.title: Metrics for a consumption ramp
drills.prompt: Set the metric the ramp must hit and the pain that makes the consumption worth paying for.

boss_fight.title: Boss fight · Eval harness
boss_fight.learner_brief: Turn a Tier-3 pilot request into a bounded 14-day eval harness with exit gates, then map the 90-day consumption ramp.
